name: sel-hybrid
description: Property keywords for the 3DEC 7.0 legacy SEL hybrid bolt element ('sel hybrid create by-line ... / sel hybrid property <i> <keyword> <value>'). 7.0-only: in 9.x hybrid bolts moved to the unified structure family (structure hybrid, with dowel segments). Scripting access: itasca.sel.cable (elements) + itasca.sel.node.

property_groups.name: Properties
property_groups.description: Live-enumerated on 3DEC 7.00 Release 161 via a bogus property-name probe on 'sel hybrid property' with elements present. Semantics are static-grade (7.0 HTML page).

properties.description: Set dowel shear force yield limit [F].
Set grout cohesive strength, c_g. [F / L]
Set the length of the grout perimeter. Only required if grout friction angle is greater than 0.
Set the axial strain at which the hybrid element will rupture and carry no axial load.
Set tensile yield strength, F_t [F]. The hybrid cannot sustain axial load above f.
